text:
Anya: Quick check — proposal to remove sidecar for Private mode and instead rely on a slim adapter in the runtime. Goal: unify handshake surface across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Thoughts?
Mike: big +1 for simplification, but main worry is authz secrets propagation and KMS access. How does cust KMS keychain get exposed without sidecar?
Joan: sidecar currently handles token refresh & per-tenant scoped credentials. If we remove it we need a clear audit trail and secret rotation story.
Kyle: Also runtime process isolation is a concern — sidecar provides an ops boundary for evictions & restarts. What's the plan for eviction semantics?
Anya: Good points. Sketch: adapter embedded in runtime but runs as a separate process group with kernel-level socket isolation. Auth flow: runtime talks to control plane via short-lived signed certs; control plane holds KMS privileges. Customers for Private can enable a "local-kms-proxy" feature flag to forward requests to their KMS.
Rachel: That sounds viable. Can we keep a compatibility shim for 6 months? Feature flag + fallthrough to sidecar.
Mike: Compatibility shim is essential. Also need a rollout gating matrix: latency, error rate, tenant separation tests. Add load tests for prefix cache impact.
Joan: Will the embedded adapter accept manifest changes at runtime? Sidecar used to hot-reload credential bundles.
Anya: Yes, plan is to expose a manifest watcher that pushes deltas via the existing controlplane sync channel. No full restart on credential change.
Kyle: For canary, suggest: 1) internal tenants only, 2) low-traffic customers, 3) track token issuance, KMS ops, eviction spikes. Create an automated rollback flag.
Rachel: Ops playbook draft: "switch-to-legacy-sidecar" toggle, tracing span tags (hosting.mode, adapter.variant), perf dashboards pre/post. I'll add the tracing bits.
SRE-bot: deploy-check: canary gate ok for runtime 2026-02-10. perf baseline collected.
Anya: Next steps: write a slim RFC with diagram + compatibility matrix. Assign owners: Anya (RFC), Mike (auth/KMS), Joan (load/eviction tests), Kyle (canary plan), Rachel (ops/tracing). Anything else?
Mike: Add a secure audit sink requirement. Logs must not contain raw tenant secrets.
Joan: Also confirm metric cardinality impact of per-tenant manifests.
Rachel: I'll schedule a 30m sync after RFC is up. :calendar: 
Anya: Thanks — filing RFC today, ping when ready.
